materials.current_state: Not present — only a single latest reference per material.
materials.issue: No multi-observation history stored, so no trend computed.

materials.action: Add a provenance tri-state with source+date per price; never silently overwrite user inputs.

materials.issue: No baseline save or indicative movement calc.
materials.action: Add SAVE BOM BASELINE → INDICATIVE MATERIAL COST MOVEMENT (never labelled actual selling-price change).

directory.current_state: manufacturers.json keyed by country (country -> [makers]); accessories.json has categories+suppliers; none is a canonical Company entity spanning categories.

directory.current_state: Not built as a categories architecture.
directory.issue: The high-value B2B/testing surface is absent.
